# vcp_networks (Data Source)

Fetches a list of all isolated networks in your account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all isolated networks in the project.
data "vcp_networks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) List of all networks in your account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) The creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `description` (String) The description of the network.
- `gateway_ids` (List of String) List of gateway IDs attached to this network.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the network.
- `location_id` (String) The location ID where the network is deployed.
- `mask` (Number) The network mask (e.g., `24`).
- `name` (String) The name of the network.
- `network_prefix` (String) The network prefix (e.g., `10.100.0.0`).
- `server_ids` (List of String) List of server IDs attached to this network.
- `tags` (Set of String) List of tags associated with the network.
